criteria.criterion: Keep one CTA and disclose that the product, proof, price, and ship date are unvalidated.
criteria.evidence: The page uses Join the early-access waitlist for all three CTA placements and repeatedly labels the extension unbuilt, proof absent, $9 pricing planned, and ship date unknown.

criteria.criterion: Provide numeric timeboxed success and kill rules with warm and cold traffic reported separately.
criteria.evidence: The dated 10-day protocol defines minimum samples, numeric strong/weak/park rules, a $150 cap, and separate warm, cold-community, cold-social, and cold-paid rows and conclusions.

criteria.criterion: Include full English copy, UTMs, a materialized minimal deployable page whose form counts only provider-confirmed success, preserves source attribution on each confirmed subscriber, and never presents an unverified attempt as confirmed success, plus at least three concrete channels, non-build scope, and a decision matrix.
criteria.evidence: Eight retained files include full copy, page/meta/OG, a deployable Pages site, TypeScript Function, UTMs, ledger, three-plus channels, non-build list, and decision matrix. The Function returns 201 only after Buttondown success and stores every UTM, variant, and traffic class on the subscriber; the browser emits Waitlist Confirmed and success UI only after that 201.

criteria.criterion: Fabricate proof, promise availability, build the product, or pool warm and cold conversion.
criteria.evidence: The copy explicitly rejects logos, testimonials, user counts, availability, and ship-date claims; the non-build list excludes extension/product code, and warm traffic cannot satisfy any cold decision rule.
